plan: An assassin who vanishes in her smoke and chains dashes to finish off her targets.
aSurveiller: Her W (Twilight Shroud). Inside her smoke she is invisible: use a control ward or an area spell to hit her.
contrer: Keep a control ward for her smoke (W): it reveals Akali.
Turrets can see her in her smoke: fight near them.
After her E and her R, she can't escape anymore: use your crowd control.
forces: Very mobile with her E and her R.
faiblesses: Relies on energy: she runs out fast.

sorts.P: Hitting a champion creates a ring; leaving it empowers her attack.
sorts.Q: Throws kunai in a fan that slow at max range.
sorts.E: Backflip and shuriken; she can dash to the target hit.
sorts.R: Two dashes: the second executes based on missing health.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, very strong in the mid game.
